summary: HTTPS listener verified on :8788 (self-signed cert at ~/.claude/orchestrator/certs). Daemon serves /mcp over both http:8787 and https:8788. TRUST STEP REMAINS FOR USER: run `bash ~/.claude/orchestrator/scripts/setup-https.sh` (mkcert -install needs keychain password) to replace the self-signed cert with a locally-trusted one, then add a custom connector at https://localhost:8788/mcp.
